listing.title: WageFlow: Hours & Salary
listing.short_description: Track daily working hours, lunch breaks, overtime pay, and weekly salary.
listing.full_description:
WageFlow is an offline working hours and salary calculator designed to track daily shifts, lunch breaks, overtime hours, Saturday weekly payouts, and monthly earnings on your device.

Key Features:
• Daily Shift & Lunch Break Logging: Record shift start and end times, deduct lunch break minutes, and add optional shift notes for each day of the week.
• Automatic Overtime Calculation: Track regular working hours against your standard daily target and add extra overtime hours with configurable rate multipliers.
• Monday to Saturday Weekly Salary: View your Monday through Saturday work week summary, total working hours, total lunch time, and Saturday payday totals, and mark weekly payouts as paid.
• Quick Shift Logging: Log a standard daily shift in one tap or pre-fill an entire Monday to Saturday work week with default shift hours.
• Monthly Income & Salary Reports: Review monthly earnings, regular versus overtime pay breakdowns, weekly payout summaries, and daily logs across any month.
• Shareable Salary Statements: Generate formatted plain-text monthly salary statements to copy to your clipboard or share via installed apps.
• Interactive Wage Calculator & Custom Rates: Customize your hourly wage rate, currency symbol, standard daily hours, default lunch break duration, and overtime multiplier, or run instant pay simulations.
• Local On-Device Storage: All work logs, weekly payout statuses, and rate settings are stored locally on your device using an offline Room database.

capability_inventory.capability: App display name ('WageFlow') and zero runtime/install permissions declared
Daily shift logging with start time, end time, lunch break deduction in minutes, and shift notes
Automatic regular vs. overtime working hours and pay calculation with configurable standard hours and overtime multiplier
Monday to Saturday weekly salary calculation, whole-week hours aggregation, and Saturday payout status toggle
One-tap quick shift logging and Monday-to-Saturday bulk week pre-filling
Monthly total income dashboard, regular vs. overtime pay breakdown, and weekly Saturday payout breakdown
Plain-text monthly salary report generation with Android clipboard copy and system share sheet (Intent.ACTION_SEND)
Interactive hourly/overtime wage simulator and configurable rate settings (hourly rate defaulting to ₹40/hr, overtime multiplier, standard daily hours, default lunch minutes, currency symbol)
Local offline data persistence for work entries, weekly payout statuses, and user wage settings via Room SQLite database

omitted_for_lack_of_evidence: Cloud sync, multi-device backup, or employer payroll integration — omitted because all data is stored strictly locally on-device via Room (WageDatabase) with no network or cloud backend calls.

PDF/Excel file attachment export — omitted because the monthly report generator outputs formatted plain text for clipboard copying and system sharing (Intent.ACTION_SEND) rather than binary PDF/XLSX files.
